capabilities: Scroll notes with vim keys (j/k, d/u, gg/G) in Reading mode
Select links and embeds with f hints and open persistent previews or splits
Copy code blocks and inline code via y/Y hints
Fold heading sections with F hints
Dim surrounding text with a reading focus mode (z)
disambiguation: Only applies in Reading mode and Bases files; it does not add Vim keys to the editor and does not require Obsidian's Vim key bindings setting.
extras: Bases keyboard navigation is experimental and off by default, relying on Obsidian internals that an update may break; the README also documents exact limits of the cursor-placement behavior and external-link confirmation before opening in the system browser.
intentEvidence: A fork of xlongfeng/obsidian-vim-scrolling that adds plain d/u half-page scrolling
problem: Obsidian's Reading mode offers no keyboard controls for scrolling, selecting links, or previewing targets, so reading requires reaching for the mouse.

relations.evidence: A fork of obsidian-vim-scrolling by xlongfeng. The original provides the reading-mode scrolling and cursor-adjustment behaviour

summary: Keyboard navigation plugin for Reading mode: Vim-style scrolling, Vimium-style link hints, persistent link previews, code copy, heading folds, and a reading focus dimmer.
